Map roles to named people or governed groups. Require one accountable assignment per deliverable unless a documented governance rule permits otherwise. Finance validates benefits even where the Business Owner remains accountable. Support authorized delegation with effective dates, absence handling and preserved audit identity; delegation must not create approval loops.

Provide an in-app committee workflow: draft agenda → gather linked decision briefs → review materials → record attendance/quorum where configured → record decisions → approve/publish minutes → assign actions → monitor closure. Executive asks require decision, why now, options, recommendation, delay impact, decision owner and required date. Read-only presentation mode and printable packs must use the same underlying records.

Approvals need assignee, request version, due date, rationale, comments and decision timestamp. Support sequential or parallel approval rules and separation of duties. A requester cannot approve their own request when the configured policy prohibits it. Reject stale approvals if the submitted record version changed. Distinguish approval, rejection, request changes and deferral. A timer may escalate an overdue approval; it must never approve it automatically.

|Dependencies       |Cross-functional blockers and affected scope                |Needed-by date and supported critical-path logic|
|Decisions          |Ask, owner, deadline and delay impact                       |Overdue executive decisions are red             |
|People and adoption|Usage, behavior and capability indicators                   |Adoption trajectory                             |

Generate charter, diagnostic, TOM, business cases, roadmap, registers, meeting minutes, gate packs, executive dashboard and handover outputs inside the application. Include native reading/presentation views and actual export functions for relevant PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and CSV outputs. A report export must contain the selected records, not a generic placeholder. Spreadsheet exports must neutralize formula injection in user text while preserving deliberately authored numeric formulas where applicable.

Reporting snapshots must retain as-of time, reporting period, source record revisions, methodology version, calculation versions and approval state. Live reports may refresh; issued snapshots remain immutable. Label provisional/unvalidated values clearly and preserve bilingual layout in exports.

Provide a secure evidence repository with record linkage, evidence type, source, owner, observation period, upload date, version, checksum and review status. Support native evidence notes and common documents/images, with file-type/size controls and safe preview/download. A filename or inaccessible external link is not verified evidence. Preserve evidence access after ownership transfer and apply the same authorization to downloads and previews as to the parent record.

16 Portable architecture and data model

Use a maintainable modular monolith with a separate background worker before considering distributed microservices. Prefer the following portable baseline unless an existing approved repository or documented IT constraint requires an equivalent:

• A TypeScript web frontend using React or an equivalent maintainable open-source UI stack.
• A TypeScript server/API with explicit modules for identity/access, transformation records, workflows, formulas, reporting and administration.
• PostgreSQL for relational records, configuration, reporting snapshots and durable workflow state.
• A durable worker/scheduler backed by the database; add a separate queue service only if justified and included in the self-hosted package.
• An evidence-storage adapter with a private filesystem option and an optional IT-approved object-store adapter.
• Standards-based enterprise identity integration through OIDC, using the corporate identity provider. Where SAML is required, provide a documented compatible broker/adapter. A self-hosted identity provider such as Keycloak can be used for a portable integration test.
• Docker container images and Compose configuration for reproducible installation and testing. Provide deployment configuration for the actual IT orchestration target when known; do not present a local Compose demonstration as proof of high-availability production readiness.

Verify current official documentation, support windows, licenses and security maintenance before selecting exact dependency versions. Pin compatible versions and lockfiles. Keep mandatory services runnable within company-controlled infrastructure. Third-party licenses remain applicable; include a license inventory and flag any procurement requirement.

Use typed relational tables for core entities and validated metadata/JSON structures for extensible custom fields and versioned forms. Avoid a single unvalidated JSON blob as the entire database.

• Transformation, PerformanceArea, Charter, MethodologyVersion, Phase, GateDefinition, GateInstance and GateDecision.
• DiagnosticFinding, Baseline, Evidence, ValuePool, Outcome and StrategicGuardrail.
• KPIDefinition, KPIVersion, KPIActual, TargetTrajectory, CalculationRun and DataQualityFinding.
• TOMDimension, TOMCanvas, Capability, Gap, Journey, Process, ProcedureDefinition and ProcedureInstance.
• Initiative, Deliverable, Milestone, RoadmapWave, Dependency, ResourceDemand, Capacity and FundingDecision.
• BusinessCase, Scenario, Benefit, BenefitAllocation, BenefitFormulaVersion, BenefitMeasurement and FinanceValidation.
• Risk, Assumption, Issue, Action, Decision, ChangeRequest and Approval.
• Forum, Meeting, AgendaItem, Attendance, Minutes and MeetingActionLink.
• StakeholderGroup, AdoptionIntervention, Training/AssessmentRecord and AdoptionMetricLink.
• BAUHandover, Control, ControlCheck, ImprovementItem, Lesson and HealthAssessment.
• FormSchemaVersion, AutomationRuleVersion, Job, Notification, IntegrationRun, ReportSnapshot and AuditEvent.

Use canonical reference links, uniqueness constraints, required ownership and explicit status transitions. Protect finalized records and evidence from destructive deletion. Define retention and archival policies; soft deletion is not a substitute for an approved retention policy. Preserve financial precision with decimal arithmetic. Add optimistic concurrency control so simultaneous edits cannot silently overwrite one another.

Expose documented versioned APIs with server-side validation, consistent error handling, pagination and authorization. Generated exports and search indexes must enforce the same scopes as record views. Use a constrained service identity for each connector and background job. Avoid exposing secrets or private evidence URLs in client code or logs.

Implement secure sessions, role/scoped authorization, input sanitization, protection against common injection and request attacks, upload restrictions, rate limiting, dependency checks and a secret-management interface. Production secrets are runtime configuration, not repository content. Integrate TLS and database/storage encryption with the hosting environment. Audit actor, action, timestamp, record ID, prior/new version and reason; append-only audit data must be protected from ordinary user modification.

# Permissions matrix: role × record × action

- **Task:** T-DG0-AN-02 (transformation-analyst). **Stage:** P0 / DG0. **Status:** specification only; nothing is implemented yet.
- **Sources:**
  - master prompt §10 (M0187, M0188, M0211, M0213), §6 (M0156), §12 (M0221, M0242) and §13 (M0255);
  - playbook minimum governance roles (B0018), T11 (B0099) and T12 RACI (B0101), through REQ-PB-012/013/065/067;
  - §16 (scoped authorization, audit) is AN-03's area and is referenced here only for context.
- **Requirements implemented by this matrix:** REQ-S10-001…004, REQ-S10-008…010, REQ-S10-014…019, REQ-S06-010, REQ-S12-003, REQ-S12-026, REQ-S13-014, REQ-PB-012 and REQ-PB-013.

The playbook is a practical synthesis *inspired by* PMI, Brightline and BRM, with custom extensions. Nothing here is an official PMI standard, a certified role model or a Mobily-approved access policy. Default assignments are a **configurable starting point**. Mobily's business owners must confirm them before production.

## 1. Roles

| Code | Role | Origin | Typical scope of assignment |
|---|---|---|---|
| SP | Executive Sponsor | Source (B0018) | Transformation |
| TL | Transformation Lead | Source (B0018) | Transformation |
| BO | Business Owner | Source (B0018) | Transformation, business unit, performance area |
| WL | Workstream Lead | Source (B0018) | Workstream, or initiatives within a transformation |
| FIN | Finance / Value Office | Source (B0018) | Transformation, or business unit (validator pool) |
| TO | Transformation Office | Source (B0018) | Organization or portfolio (PMO function) |
| KDS | KPI/Data Steward | Implementation (M0187) | KPIs or performance areas |
| TD | Tech/Data contributor | Implementation (M0187) | Initiatives, dimensions, dependencies |
| CM / SEC | Committee member / secretary | Implementation (M0187) | Forum |
| AUD | Read-only auditor | Implementation (M0187) | Organization, business unit or transformation (read-only) |
| ADM | System administrator (technical, access, or methodology admin sub-profiles) | Implementation (M0187) | Organization (technical configuration only) |

## 2. Scope rules (REQ-S10-002, REQ-S10-004)

1. **Every grant is a ScopedAssignment.** A grant is (user or governed group, role, scope). Scope is one of Organization, BusinessUnit, Portfolio, Transformation, Workstream/Initiative, PerformanceArea or Forum.
   - A grant at a wider scope covers narrower scopes only where the role row below says "inherits".
   - By default TO and AUD inherit downward. SP, TL, BO, WL, FIN, KDS and TD do **not** inherit to sibling transformations.
2. **Job title never grants access across all transformations.** No role is granted implicitly from HR attributes. Identity-provider groups map to scoped assignments explicitly, under IT control.
3. **Sensitive records** need an explicit record-level grant in addition to scope. Examples: named-person HR impacts in T13, commercially sensitive business-case lines and restricted evidence. Default holders are SP, TL, FIN and the record owner.
4. **One authorization layer is enforced on the server** for every path:
   - record reads and writes;
   - file download and preview (REQ-S13-014);
   - API calls;
   - exports and report generation;
   - search results and suggestions;
   - notification deep links (REQ-S12-024);
   - AI retrieval context (§17, AN-03).

   Unauthorized reads return 404 or 403 without leaking titles.
5. **Background jobs and connectors** act under the initiating user or a constrained service identity scoped to the rule (REQ-S12-003). A service identity never holds approval rights.
6. **Demo environment** users see only demo data. Production has no demo users (REQ-S18-001, REQ-S18-003; former REQ-S02-007 was consolidated into REQ-S18-001 in AN-04).

## 3. Action codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| C | Create |
| U | Update (drafts, owned data) |
| S | Submit (for review, approval or validation) |
| Rv | Review, recommend, comment or consult (per T11/RACI "Consult"/"Recommend") |

| Va | Finance validation (attestation) |
| Ac | Accept (receiving owner) |
| Cf | Configure (methodology/Studio, workflow, calendar, access) |
| V | View (scoped) |
| — | No access |

1:# Decisions and assumptions
46:| D-047 | 2026-10-01 | delivery-orchestrator | **DG1 register reconciliation for REQ-S16-003 and REQ-S15-002 (two gaps the T-DG1-REG analyst correctly refused to mark IMPLEMENTED).** (1) **REQ-S16-003** ("a TypeScript API with explicit modules for identity/access, transformation records, workflows, formulas, reporting and administration"; A12 = the six modules exist with separate test suites + a dependency-lint check). The DG1 deliverable is the module **architecture**: `apps/api/src/modules.ts` declares **all** module boundaries and their dependency-direction rules (including `workflows`, `kpi` [formulas], `reporting` as **reserved** names), and `apps/api/src/architecture.test.ts` is the dependency-lint that fails on any import bypassing a module interface, across every declared module. Per the staging plan (ADR-0002; `P1_MODULES`; stage-plan), the eight P1-active modules (platform, audit, identity, access, organization, transformations, jobs, admin) are implemented and unit-tested at DG1; workflows (P2+), kpi/formulas (P4) and reporting (P5) are **declared-but-reserved boundaries** whose code and own test suites land in those stages — "later stages add code, not new boundaries." REQ-S16-003's DG1 increment (explicit module boundaries + enforced dependency-lint + the P1-active modules) is therefore met; its note records that the reserved modules' suites complete in P2/P4/P5. (2) **REQ-S15-002** (A20 needs `GET /api/v1/branding/tokens` returning the seven tokens with `provenance=provisional`): the endpoint was genuinely missing from the P1 build — **it is being added** (contract operation `getBrandingTokens` + `BrandingTokens` schema in `docs/api/openapi.yaml`; implementation T-DG1-BE2), not scope-deferred, because its final gate is DG1. | Found by the T-DG1-REG analyst (it marked 10/12 IMPLEMENTED and left these two SPECIFIED with notes rather than fake them — the intended behaviour). The reviewers assess the REQ-S16-003 scope reading against the staging plan. | If a reviewer judges REQ-S16-003's A12 to require full implementations of all six modules at DG1 (not the architecture + P1-active set), REQ-S16-003's final_gate moves later or the reserved modules are built now. |
47:| D-048 | 2026-10-01 | delivery-orchestrator | **DG1 round-1 reviewers rejected D-047's "architecture-only" reading of REQ-S16-003; the three reserved modules are BUILT now (supersedes D-047 part 1).** All three DG1 round-1 reviewers (domain F-DG1-105 Medium/mandatory; code-security; qa) read A12 ("the six modules exist with separate test suites + a dependency-lint check") **literally**: `workflows`, `kpi`/formulas and `reporting` must EXIST as modules with their own test suites at DG1, not merely as reserved names in `modules.ts`. D-047's revisit-when triggered. **Decision:** the three modules are promoted from reserved to **active P1 scaffolds** — each gets `apps/api/src/modules/<m>/index.ts` (a typed public interface and a `register<M>Module` wiring hook, no business behaviour yet), is listed in `P1_MODULES` with its dependency-direction rules in `modules.ts`, is covered by `architecture.test.ts`, and has its **own** test suite (`apps/api/src/modules/<m>/<m>.test.ts`) asserting the module is registered and its boundary is enforced. The six §16 business modules (identity/access, transformations, workflows, formulas/KPI, reporting, admin) therefore all exist with separate suites, meeting A12 **literally**. Their business behaviour still lands in its stage (workflows P2, formulas/KPI P4, reporting P5) — "later stages add code, not new boundaries" — but the module and its suite now exist. Implemented under T-DG1-BE3; the register (REQ-S16-003/004) is corrected by T-DG1-ANALYST2 to describe the six-module scaffold set (closes F-DG1-105, F-DG1-002, F-DG1-207's REQ-S16-003 item). | The round-1 reviewers' consensus; master prompt §16 ("explicit modules for identity/access, transformation records, workflows, formulas, reporting and administration"). **Evidence:** the three module dirs + `index.ts` + per-module `*.test.ts`; `modules.ts` `P1_MODULES` now eleven; `architecture.test.ts` dependency-lint green with a planted-violation check; the register rows corrected. | A reserved module's real behaviour arrives in its stage; the scaffold's interface is expected to grow, not its boundary. |

# Entity-relationship model

- **Task:** T-DG1-ARCH-01 (solution-architect), 2026-09-30.
- **Covers:** master prompt §16 "Minimum domain entities", all twelve groups (REQ-S16-011…022).
- **Detail:** the physical columns of the tables P1 implements are in `data-dictionary.md`.
- **Marking:**
  - **P1** means the table is created by P1 migrations.
  - `Px` names the stage that adds the table.
  - Entity names are conceptual. Table names are snake_case singular, and `User` becomes `app_user` because `user` is a reserved word.

## Conventions shared by every table (ADR-0003/0004)

- `id uuid` (UUIDv7, app-generated) primary key.
- `organization_id` on every tenant-scoped row.
- `version integer` (optimistic concurrency) on every mutable row.
- `created_at`/`updated_at timestamptz` and `created_by`/`updated_by`.
- Explicit status columns with CHECK-constrained values and documented transitions.
- `ON DELETE RESTRICT` foreign keys.
- No hard deletes of business records.
- Money is `numeric` plus `currency`.
- Extensible custom fields live in `custom_field_values jsonb`, validated against the pinned `form_schema_version` (ADR-0014).

**Canonical shared records:**
- **one `decision` model:** T04 design decisions, T11 decision-right decisions, T16 executive decisions and gate decisions all reference or specialise it;
- **one `dependency` record**, shared by T08 and RAID;
- **one benefit register:** `benefit` plus `benefit_allocation`, with no duplicated benefit rows per initiative.

Also created in P1, not drawn above:
- Three **views** (read models, `SELECT` only for `mth_app`; columns in the data dictionary, section "Views"). They store no data:
  - `actor_display` (0001) is derived from `app_user` as `(user_id, display_name)`. Audit reads actor names through it.
  - `business_unit_closure` (0001) is the recursive closure of `business_unit` `parent of`, as `(ancestor_id, descendant_id, organization_id, depth)` with depth 0–10. The policy function uses it for downward inheritance, and the organization module for cycle and depth checks.
  - `scope_node` (0002) is the `UNION ALL` of `organization`, `business_unit` and `transformation`, as `(scope_type, scope_id, organization_id, business_unit_id, transformation_id)`. It resolves the scope that a `scoped_assignment` points at.
- The `business_unit` self-relation is acyclic and at most 10 levels deep. The database enforces this with the trigger `business_unit_hierarchy_guard` (0009, F-DG1-140) in addition to the API check.
- `schema_migration`: migration bookkeeping.
- The `pgboss.*` schema: owned and migrated by pg-boss (ADR-0008). This is P1's "job tables as required by the queue choice", and the physical form of the §16 entity **Job**.

Also created in P1, not drawn above:

  - `actor_display` (0001) is derived from `app_user` as `(user_id, display_name)`. Audit reads actor names through it.
  - `business_unit_closure` (0001) is the recursive closure of `business_unit` `parent of`, as `(ancestor_id, descendant_id, organization_id, depth)` with depth 0–10. The policy function uses it for downward inheritance, and the organization module for cycle and depth checks.

- The `business_unit` self-relation is acyclic and at most 10 levels deep. The database enforces this with the trigger `business_unit_hierarchy_guard` (0009, F-DG1-140) in addition to the API check.

from model import *

LINKABLE = ['charter', 'north_star', 'strategic_guardrail', 'outcome', 'kpi_definition', 'baseline', 'outcome_kpi',
            'value_pool', 'diagnostic_item', 'diagnostic_finding', 'diagnostic_workstream_output', 'tom_canvas_cell',
            'tom_gap', 'capability', 'journey', 'journey_pain_point', 'decision', 'dependency', 'tom_workshop',
            'action_item']
PHASES = ['diagnose', 'define', 'design', 'mobilize', 'transform', 'realize']


def CAT_HEAD(code_re, ord_max):
    return [
        ID(),
        Col("code", "text", null=False, unique=True, check=f"code ~ '{code_re}'", doc="Stable language-neutral key"),
        Col("methodology_version_id", "uuid", null=False, ref="methodology_version (id)", doc="Version that introduced the row"),
        Col("ordinal", "smallint", null=False, unique=True, check=f"ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND {ord_max}", doc="Display order"),
    ]


def q(s):
    return "'" + s.replace("'", "''") + "'"


# ================================================================================================ 0011 methodology
methodology_version = Table(
    "methodology_version", "Immutable published methodology versions (ADR-0014). P2 seeds the playbook v1.0 version.",
    "methodology", "ADM_METHOD (publish in P5)",
    [ID(),
     Col("key", "text", null=False, check="key ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$'"),
     Col("version_no", "integer", null=False, check="version_no >= 1"),
     ENUM("status", ["draft", "published", "retired"], default="draft"),
     TEXT("title_en", 200, null=False), TEXT("title_ar", 200, null=False),
     TEXT("source_document", 500, null=False, doc="e.g. Business Transformation Playbook v1.0"),
     Col("source_sha256", "char(64)", check="source_sha256 IS NULL OR source_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'"),
     Col("definition", "jsonb", null=False, check="jsonb_typeof(definition) = 'object'",
         doc="Validated against the platform meta-schema (ADR-0014); never an unvalidated blob"),
     Col("content_sha256", "char(64)", null=False, check="content_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'"),
     Col("published_at", "timestamptz"), USER("published_by"),
     *STAMPS(creator_null=True)],
    constraints=["CONSTRAINT methodology_version_key_no_key UNIQUE (key, version_no)",
                 "CONSTRAINT methodology_version_published_complete CHECK ((status = 'draft') = (published_at IS NULL))"],
    after=["""CREATE FUNCTION methodology_version_published_immutable() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.status <> 'draft' AND (NEW.definition IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.definition
      OR NEW.content_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.content_sha256 OR NEW.key IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.key
      OR NEW.version_no IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.version_no) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'methodology_version %/%: a published definition is immutable (ADR-0014)', OLD.key, OLD.version_no
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'methodology_version_published_immutable';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER methodology_version_published_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON methodology_version
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION methodology_version_published_immutable();"""],
    grants="SELECT", guards="none", status="draft → published → retired (publishing arrives with Playbook Studio, P5)",
    invariants=["A published definition, key and version_no never change (trigger).",
                "Read-only for mth_app in P2."])

transformation_config_pin = Table(
    "transformation_config_pin", "Configuration version a transformation is pinned to (ADR-0014). P2: kind = methodology.",
    "methodology", "TL/TO (via transformation creation); migration by change request in P5",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     ENUM("kind", ["methodology"], doc="P5 adds form_schema, kpi_formula, benefit_formula, automation_rule"),
     Col("methodology_version_id", "uuid", null=False, ref="methodology_version (id)"),
     Col("pinned_at", "timestamptz", null=False, default="now()"),
     USER("pinned_by", null=False),
     *STAMPS()],
    constraints=["CONSTRAINT transformation_config_pin_kind_key UNIQUE (transformation_id, kind)"],
    status="n/a (re-pinning is a P5 change request)",
    invariants=["Exactly one methodology pin per transformation, created by p2_instantiate_transformation()."])

diagnostic_dimension = Table(
    "diagnostic_dimension", "T01 dimensions (B0031): Financial, Customer, Process, People / Org, Technology, Data.",
    "methodology", "ADM_METHOD (configurable additions in P5)",
    [*CAT_HEAD("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47}$", 99),
     TEXT("source_label", 100, null=False, doc="Verbatim B0031 label"),
     TEXT("label_en", 200, null=False), TEXT("label_ar", 200, null=False),
     TEXT("evidence_hint_en", 200, null=False, doc="Verbatim placeholder, e.g. [Metric / source]"),
     TEXT("evidence_hint_ar", 200, null=False),
     TEXT("impact_hint_en", 200, null=False, doc="Verbatim placeholder, e.g. [SAR / KPI]"),
     TEXT("impact_hint_ar", 200, null=False),
     Col("is_source_seeded", "boolean", null=False, default="true", doc="Pre-seeded into every transformation's T01"),
     ENUM("status", ["active", "retired"], default="active"),
     *STAMPS(creator_null=True)],
    grants="SELECT", guards="none", status="active | retired")

diagnostic_workstream = Table(
    "diagnostic_workstream", "The six Diagnose workstreams with key questions and typical outputs (B0029).",
    "methodology", "ADM_METHOD",
    [*CAT_HEAD("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47}$", 99),
     TEXT("source_name_en", 100, null=False), TEXT("name_ar", 200, null=False),
     TEXT("source_key_questions_en", 1000, null=False), TEXT("key_questions_ar", 1000, null=False),
     TEXT("source_typical_outputs_en", 1000, null=False), TEXT("typical_outputs_ar", 1000, null=False),
     TEXT("source_ref", 50, null=False),
     ENUM("status", ["active", "retired"], default="active"),
     *STAMPS(creator_null=True)],
    grants="SELECT", guards="none", status="active | retired")

TOM_EDITABLE = ["label_en", "label_ar", "design_question_ar", "canvas_box_ar", "canvas_prompt_ar",
                "version", "updated_at", "updated_by"]
tom_dimension = Table(
    "tom_dimension", "The ten TOM dimensions with design questions (B0056) and canvas boxes/prompts (B0062).",
    "methodology", "ADM_METHOD edits display labels; source text is immutable",
    [*CAT_HEAD("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47}$", 10),
     TEXT("source_name_en", 100, null=False, doc="Verbatim B0056 dimension name"),
     TEXT("source_design_question_en", 500, null=False, doc="Verbatim B0056"),
     TEXT("source_canvas_box_en", 100, null=False, doc="Verbatim B0062 box title"),
     TEXT("source_canvas_prompt_en", 500, null=False, doc="Verbatim B0062 prompt"),
     TEXT("label_en", 200, null=False, doc="Editable display label (defaults to the source name)"),
     TEXT("label_ar", 200, null=False),
     TEXT("design_question_ar", 500, null=False), TEXT("canvas_box_ar", 200, null=False),
     TEXT("canvas_prompt_ar", 500, null=False),
     TEXT("source_ref", 50, null=False),
     *STAMPS(creator_null=True)],
    after=[f"""CREATE FUNCTION tom_dimension_source_immutable() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
  IF (to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY[{', '.join(q(c) for c in TOM_EDITABLE)}])
     IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY[{', '.join(q(c) for c in TOM_EDITABLE)}]) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tom_dimension %: only display labels and Arabic translations are editable; source text, code and order are fixed (REQ-PB-038)', OLD.code
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'tom_dimension_source_immutable';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER tom_dimension_source_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON tom_dimension
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION tom_dimension_source_immutable();"""],
    grants="SELECT, UPDATE", guards="none",  # guards attached after the seed (see 0011 body)
    status="n/a (dimensions are permanent; they cannot be deleted)",
    invariants=["Exactly ten rows; code, ordinal and every source_* column are immutable (trigger).",
                "Label edits are versioned and audited (row guard + audit_required attached after the seed)."])

gate_definition = Table(
    "gate_definition", "Product gates G1-G6 (B0023): decision question, evidence required, default approver.",
    "methodology", "ADM_METHOD (P5); approver per transformation on gate_instance",
    [*CAT_HEAD("^G[1-6]$", 6),
     ENUM("phase", PHASES, doc="Phase the gate closes"),
     ENUM("next_phase", PHASES, null=True, doc="Phase enabled by approval (NULL for G6)"),

      OR NEW.content_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.content_sha256 OR NEW.key IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.key

  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;

outcome = Table(
    "outcome", "Strategic outcomes under the North Star, as a tree (B0048); top outcomes are the charter's 3-5.",
    "transformations", "TL, BO, KDS (outcome.edit); owner = a business leader",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("parent_outcome_id", "uuid", doc="NULL = directly under the North Star"),
     TEXT("statement", 500, null=False), TEXT("description", 4000),
     USER("owner_user_id", doc="Owned by a business leader (good outcome test)"),
     Col("is_top_outcome", "boolean", null=False, default="false", doc="Counts toward the charter's top 3-5 outcomes"),
     Col("top_rank", "smallint", check="top_rank IS NULL OR top_rank BETWEEN 1 AND 99"),
     Col("specific_confirmed", "boolean", doc="Good outcome test: Specific (user-attested)"),
     Col("strategically_relevant_confirmed", "boolean", doc="Good outcome test: Strategically relevant (user-attested)"),
     TEXT("causal_chain", 4000, doc="Good outcome test: the defined causal chain"),
     ENUM("status", ["draft", "active", "archived"], default="draft"),
     *ARCHIVE(), *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("outcome"),
                 tr_fk("outcome", "parent_outcome_id", "outcome"),
                 "CONSTRAINT outcome_not_own_parent CHECK (parent_outcome_id IS DISTINCT FROM id)",
                 "CONSTRAINT outcome_rank_only_top CHECK (top_rank IS NULL OR is_top_outcome)",
                 archive_check("outcome")],
    after=[list_index("outcome"),
           "CREATE INDEX outcome_parent_idx ON outcome (parent_outcome_id) WHERE parent_outcome_id IS NOT NULL;",
           """-- Outcome tree: acyclic and at most 6 levels below the North Star. Serialized per transformation by an advisory lock,
-- re-checked after the write (same pattern as 0009's business_unit_hierarchy_guard).
CREATE FUNCTION outcome_hierarchy_guard() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = pg_catalog, public AS $$
DECLARE
  outcome_lock_class CONSTANT integer := 730220;
  max_levels CONSTANT integer := 6;
  cur uuid;
  levels integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.parent_outcome_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(outcome_lock_class, hashtext(NEW.transformation_id::text));
  cur := NEW.parent_outcome_id;
  WHILE cur IS NOT NULL LOOP
    IF cur = NEW.id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'outcome % cannot be placed under its own descendant', NEW.id
        USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'outcome_acyclic', TABLE = 'outcome';
    END IF;
    levels := levels + 1;
    IF levels >= max_levels THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'outcome % would be nested deeper than % levels', NEW.id, max_levels
        USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'outcome_max_depth', TABLE = 'outcome';
    END IF;
    SELECT o.parent_outcome_id INTO cur FROM outcome o WHERE o.id = cur FOR SHARE;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN NULL;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER outcome_hierarchy_guard AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF parent_outcome_id ON outcome
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION outcome_hierarchy_guard();"""],
    status="draft → active; archived",
    invariants=["Tree is acyclic, ≤ 6 levels, parent in the same transformation (composite FK + trigger).",
                "Good outcome test: specific/strategic relevance/causal chain are attested here; measurable (a T02 row) and owned (owner set) are computed (ADR-0019)."])


def charter_content(versioned=False):
    cols = [
        TEXT("transformation_name", 200, doc="Field 1 Transformation name"),
        USER("executive_sponsor_user_id", doc="Field 2 Executive sponsor"),
        USER("transformation_lead_user_id", doc="Field 3 Transformation lead"),
        TEXT("case_for_change", 20000, doc="Field 4 Case for change"),
        Col("north_star_id", "uuid", doc="Field 5 North Star (the current north_star row)"),
        TEXT("in_scope", 20000, doc="Field 6 In scope"),
        TEXT("out_of_scope", 20000, doc="Field 7 Out of scope (empty fails scope check 3)"),
        Col("baseline_date", "date", doc="Field 8 Baseline date (a valid date by type)"),
        Col("target_horizon_value", "integer", check="target_horizon_value IS NULL OR target_horizon_value BETWEEN 1 AND 600",
            doc="Field 9 Target horizon (number)"),
        ENUM("target_horizon_unit", ["months", "quarters", "years"], null=True, doc="Field 9 Target horizon (unit)"),
        TEXT("governance_forum", 500, doc="Field 12 Governance forum (forum reference in P4)"),
        TEXT("decision_rights", 20000, doc="Field 13 Decision rights"),
        TEXT("success_definition", 20000, doc="Field 14 Success definition"),
        TEXT("thesis_change", 4000, doc="Thesis: If we change [capabilities / journeys / operating model]"),
        TEXT("thesis_outcomes", 4000, doc="Thesis: then [customer/operational outcomes] will improve"),
        TEXT("thesis_benefits", 4000, doc="Thesis: which will create [financial/strategic benefits]"),
        TEXT("thesis_because", 8000, doc="Thesis: because [evidence / causal logic]"),
    ]
    for c in SC_CODES:
        cols.append(ENUM(f"sc_{c}", ["yes", "partly", "no"], null=True, doc=f"Scope sanity check {c}: user response"))
        cols.append(TEXT(f"sc_{c}_evidence", 4000, doc="Evidence for the response"))
    return cols


def charter_content_checks(t):
    return [f"CONSTRAINT {t}_target_horizon_pair CHECK ((target_horizon_value IS NULL) = (target_horizon_unit IS NULL))"]


charter = Table(
    "charter", "Transformation Charter: first-class record with the 14 source fields (B0035), the thesis (B0037) and "
    "the five scope sanity check responses (B0038-B0043). Current state; every saved change appends a charter_version.",
    "transformations", "TL, TO (charter.edit); SP approves (RACI A) through G1/G2",
    [ID(), ORG(),
     Col("transformation_id", "uuid", null=False, unique=True, ref="transformation (id)", doc="One charter per transformation"),
     *charter_content(), *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("charter"), tr_fk("charter", "north_star_id", "north_star"), *charter_content_checks("charter")],
    after=["""-- History retained (REQ-PB-029): every committed charter row version has its immutable charter_version snapshot.
CREATE FUNCTION charter_version_required() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM charter_version v WHERE v.charter_id = NEW.id AND v.version_no = NEW.version) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'charter % version % has no charter_version snapshot', NEW.id, NEW.version
      USING ERRCODE = 'integrity_constraint_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'charter_version_required';
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END $$;"""],
    status="n/a: approval state lives on the G1/G2 gate submission that pins a charter version (ADR-0017)",
    invariants=["Field 10 (top 3-5 outcomes) = outcome.is_top_outcome rows; field 11 = active strategic_guardrail rows; both are snapshotted into each charter_version.",
                "charter.version = latest charter_version.version_no (deferred trigger charter_version_required)."])

    grants="SELECT, INSERT", guards="row_only", status="n/a (append-only)",
    invariants=["Append-only (trigger). Retrieved by (charter_id, version_no); the current version is charter.version."])

            "AND (validated_by IS NULL) = (validated_at IS NULL) AND (validated_at IS NULL) = (validated_record_version IS NULL))")

outcome = Table(
    "outcome", "Strategic outcomes under the North Star, as a tree (B0048); top outcomes are the charter's 3-5.",
    "transformations", "TL, BO, KDS (outcome.edit); owner = a business leader",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("parent_outcome_id", "uuid", doc="NULL = directly under the North Star"),
     TEXT("statement", 500, null=False), TEXT("description", 4000),
     USER("owner_user_id", doc="Owned by a business leader (good outcome test)"),
     Col("is_top_outcome", "boolean", null=False, default="false", doc="Counts toward the charter's top 3-5 outcomes"),
     Col("top_rank", "smallint", check="top_rank IS NULL OR top_rank BETWEEN 1 AND 99"),
     Col("specific_confirmed", "boolean", doc="Good outcome test: Specific (user-attested)"),
     Col("strategically_relevant_confirmed", "boolean", doc="Good outcome test: Strategically relevant (user-attested)"),
     TEXT("causal_chain", 4000, doc="Good outcome test: the defined causal chain"),
     ENUM("status", ["draft", "active", "archived"], default="draft"),
     *ARCHIVE(), *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("outcome"),
                 tr_fk("outcome", "parent_outcome_id", "outcome"),
                 "CONSTRAINT outcome_not_own_parent CHECK (parent_outcome_id IS DISTINCT FROM id)",
                 "CONSTRAINT outcome_rank_only_top CHECK (top_rank IS NULL OR is_top_outcome)",
                 archive_check("outcome")],
    after=[list_index("outcome"),
           "CREATE INDEX outcome_parent_idx ON outcome (parent_outcome_id) WHERE parent_outcome_id IS NOT NULL;",
           """-- Outcome tree: acyclic and at most 6 levels below the North Star. Serialized per transformation by an advisory lock,
-- re-checked after the write (same pattern as 0009's business_unit_hierarchy_guard).
CREATE FUNCTION outcome_hierarchy_guard() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = pg_catalog, public AS $$
DECLARE
  outcome_lock_class CONSTANT integer := 730220;
  max_levels CONSTANT integer := 6;
  cur uuid;
  levels integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.parent_outcome_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(outcome_lock_class, hashtext(NEW.transformation_id::text));
  cur := NEW.parent_outcome_id;
  WHILE cur IS NOT NULL LOOP
    IF cur = NEW.id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'outcome % cannot be placed under its own descendant', NEW.id
        USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'outcome_acyclic', TABLE = 'outcome';
    END IF;
    levels := levels + 1;
    IF levels >= max_levels THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'outcome % would be nested deeper than % levels', NEW.id, max_levels
        USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'outcome_max_depth', TABLE = 'outcome';
    END IF;
    SELECT o.parent_outcome_id INTO cur FROM outcome o WHERE o.id = cur FOR SHARE;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN NULL;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER outcome_hierarchy_guard AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF parent_outcome_id ON outcome
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION outcome_hierarchy_guard();"""],
    status="draft → active; archived",
    invariants=["Tree is acyclic, ≤ 6 levels, parent in the same transformation (composite FK + trigger).",

LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$

           """-- Outcome tree: acyclic and at most 6 levels below the North Star. Serialized per transformation by an advisory lock,
-- re-checked after the write (same pattern as 0009's business_unit_hierarchy_guard).
CREATE FUNCTION outcome_hierarchy_guard() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = pg_catalog, public AS $$
DECLARE
  outcome_lock_class CONSTANT integer := 730220;
  max_levels CONSTANT integer := 6;
  cur uuid;
  levels integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.parent_outcome_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(outcome_lock_class, hashtext(NEW.transformation_id::text));
  cur := NEW.parent_outcome_id;
  WHILE cur IS NOT NULL LOOP
    IF cur = NEW.id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'outcome % cannot be placed under its own descendant', NEW.id
        USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'outcome_acyclic', TABLE = 'outcome';
    END IF;
    levels := levels + 1;
    IF levels >= max_levels THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'outcome % would be nested deeper than % levels', NEW.id, max_levels
        USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'outcome_max_depth', TABLE = 'outcome';
    END IF;
    SELECT o.parent_outcome_id INTO cur FROM outcome o WHERE o.id = cur FOR SHARE;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN NULL;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER outcome_hierarchy_guard AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF parent_outcome_id ON outcome
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION outcome_hierarchy_guard();"""],

     Col("baseline_id", "uuid", doc="... and/or a baseline registry reference"),
     TEXT("root_cause", 20000, doc="Root cause"),
     TEXT("impact_text", 4000, doc="Impact (text) ..."),
     Col("impact_amount", "numeric(20,4)", doc="... a SAR amount ..."),
     CURRENCY("impact_currency", null=True),
     Col("impact_kpi_definition_id", "uuid", doc="... or a KPI"),
     CONF(), USER("owner_user_id"),
     ENUM("status", ["active", "archived"], default="active"),
     *ARCHIVE(), *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("diagnostic_item"),
                 tr_fk("diagnostic_item", "baseline_id", "baseline"),
                 tr_fk("diagnostic_item", "impact_kpi_definition_id", "kpi_definition"),
                 "CONSTRAINT diagnostic_item_impact_money_pair CHECK ((impact_amount IS NULL) = (impact_currency IS NULL))",
                 "CONSTRAINT diagnostic_item_seeded_not_archived CHECK (NOT (is_seeded AND status = 'archived'))",
                 archive_check("diagnostic_item")],
    after=[list_index("diagnostic_item"),
           "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX diagnostic_item_seeded_key ON diagnostic_item (transformation_id, dimension_code) WHERE is_seeded;"],
    status="active | archived (seeded rows cannot be archived)",
    invariants=["Confidence ∈ {H, M, L} or NULL (CHECK; the API answers 400 for anything else).",
                "Exactly one seeded row per seeded dimension per transformation (partial unique index)."])

diagnostic_finding = Table(
    "diagnostic_finding", "A diagnostic finding in a workstream, classified to separate symptoms from root causes (REQ-S04-003).",
    "transformations", "TL, TO (diagnostic.edit), WL (diagnostic.contribute, own)",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("workstream_code", "text", null=False, ref="diagnostic_workstream (code)"),
     Col("diagnostic_item_id", "uuid", doc="T01 row it supports"),
     ENUM("kind", ["symptom", "root_cause", "opportunity", "observation"]),
     TEXT("statement", 2000, null=False), TEXT("detail", 20000),
     CONF(), USER("owner_user_id"),
     ENUM("status", ["draft", "confirmed", "rejected", "archived"], default="draft"),
     *ARCHIVE(), *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("diagnostic_finding"), tr_fk("diagnostic_finding", "diagnostic_item_id", "diagnostic_item"),
                 archive_check("diagnostic_finding")],
    after=[list_index("diagnostic_finding")],
    status="draft → confirmed | rejected; archived")

diagnostic_workstream_output = Table(
    "diagnostic_workstream_output", "An output attached to one of the six workstreams, as a linked record and/or evidence (REQ-PB-023).",
    "transformations", "TL, TO (diagnostic.edit), WL (diagnostic.contribute, own)",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("workstream_code", "text", null=False, ref="diagnostic_workstream (code)"),
     TEXT("title", 300, null=False), TEXT("output_kind", 100, doc="e.g. Baseline P&L bridge (free label)"),
     ENUM("record_type", ["diagnostic_item", "diagnostic_finding", "baseline", "value_pool", "capability", "journey",
                          "kpi_definition"], null=True),
     Col("record_id", "uuid"),
     Col("evidence_id", "uuid"),
     TEXT("note", 4000),
     ENUM("status", ["active", "archived"], default="active"),
     *ARCHIVE(), *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("diagnostic_workstream_output"),
                 tr_fk("diagnostic_workstream_output", "evidence_id", "evidence"),
                 "CONSTRAINT diagnostic_workstream_output_record_pair CHECK ((record_type IS NULL) = (record_id IS NULL))",
                 "CONSTRAINT diagnostic_workstream_output_has_target CHECK (record_id IS NOT NULL OR evidence_id IS NOT NULL)",
                 archive_check("diagnostic_workstream_output")],
    after=[list_index("diagnostic_workstream_output"),
           "CREATE TRIGGER diagnostic_workstream_output_record_ref BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF record_type, record_id ON diagnostic_workstream_output\n"
           "  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION p2_record_ref_guard();"],
    status="active | archived")

# ==================================================================================================== 0016 design
tom_canvas_cell = Table(
    "tom_canvas_cell", "One TOM Canvas box per dimension per transformation (B0062): current/target design and owner. "
    "Ten rows pre-created per transformation.",
    "transformations", "TL, BO (tom.edit); BO approves the target state (T11) through G3",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("dimension_code", "text", null=False, ref="tom_dimension (code)"),
     TEXT("current_design", 20000), TEXT("target_design", 20000, doc="[Write target-state design here]"),
     USER("owner_user_id", doc="Dimension owner (missing = flagged in G3 readiness)"),
     ENUM("status", ["draft", "ready"], default="draft"),
     *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("tom_canvas_cell"),
                 "CONSTRAINT tom_canvas_cell_dimension_key UNIQUE (transformation_id, dimension_code)",
                 "CONSTRAINT tom_canvas_cell_ready_complete CHECK (status <> 'ready' OR (target_design IS NOT NULL AND owner_user_id IS NOT NULL))"],
    status="draft → ready")

tom_gap = Table(
    "tom_gap", "T03 TOM Gap Matrix row (B0058): TOM dimension, current state, target state, gap, design decision, owner.",
    "transformations", "TL, BO (tom.edit); WL, TD (tom.contribute, own)",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("dimension_code", "text", null=False, ref="tom_dimension (code)", doc="TOM dimension: required (REQ-PB-039)"),
     TEXT("current_state", 20000), TEXT("target_state", 20000), TEXT("gap", 20000),
     Col("design_decision_id", "uuid", doc="Design decision (T04); FK added in 0017"),
     USER("owner_user_id"),
     ENUM("status", ["open", "resolved", "archived"], default="open"),
     *ARCHIVE(), *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("tom_gap"), archive_check("tom_gap")],
    after=[list_index("tom_gap"),
           "CREATE INDEX tom_gap_dimension_idx ON tom_gap (transformation_id, dimension_code) WHERE status <> 'archived';"],
    status="open → resolved; archived")

capability = Table(
    "capability", "Capability heatmap entry: current vs target level and build/buy/partner need (REQ-PB-024).",
    "transformations", "TL, BO (tom.edit); WL, TD (tom.contribute, own)",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     TEXT("name", 300, null=False), TEXT("description", 4000),
     Col("dimension_code", "text", ref="tom_dimension (code)"),
     Col("current_level", "smallint", check="current_level IS NULL OR current_level BETWEEN 1 AND 5", doc="1-5 (interpretation); NULL = not rated"),
     Col("target_level", "smallint", check="target_level IS NULL OR target_level BETWEEN 1 AND 5"),
     ENUM("sourcing_need", ["build", "buy", "partner", "undecided"], null=True),
     USER("owner_user_id"),
     Col("tom_gap_id", "uuid", doc="Linked T03 gap"),
     ENUM("status", ["active", "archived"], default="active"),
     *ARCHIVE(), *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("capability"), tr_fk("capability", "tom_gap_id", "tom_gap"), archive_check("capability")],
    after=[list_index("capability")],
    status="active | archived",
    invariants=["Gap = target_level − current_level, computed; unrated levels give an Unknown gap, never 0."])

journey = Table(
    "journey", "Journey or process map, current or future state (REQ-PB-025); steps with actors, handoffs, systems, controls.",
    "transformations", "TL, BO (tom.edit); WL, TD (tom.contribute, own)",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     TEXT("name", 300, null=False),
     ENUM("kind", ["journey", "process"]),
     ENUM("state", ["current", "future"], doc="Future journeys are G3 evidence"),
     TEXT("description", 20000),
     Col("dimension_code", "text", ref="tom_dimension (code)"),
     Col("steps", "jsonb", null=False, default="'[]'::jsonb",
         check="jsonb_typeof(steps) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(steps) <= 200",
         doc="[{key: uuid, name, actor, handoffTo, systems, controls, cycleTime}] (zod-validated)"),
     Col("cycle_time_value", "numeric(14,4)", check="cycle_time_value IS NULL OR cycle_time_value >= 0"),
     ENUM("cycle_time_unit", ["minutes", "hours", "days", "weeks"], null=True),
     TEXT("failure_demand", 4000),
     USER("owner_user_id"),
     ENUM("status", ["draft", "active", "archived"], default="draft"),
     *ARCHIVE(), *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("journey"),
                 "CONSTRAINT journey_cycle_time_pair CHECK ((cycle_time_value IS NULL) = (cycle_time_unit IS NULL))",
                 archive_check("journey")],
    after=[list_index("journey"),
           "CREATE INDEX journey_state_idx ON journey (transformation_id, state) WHERE status <> 'archived';"],
    status="draft → active; archived")

journey_pain_point = Table(
    "journey_pain_point", "A pain point on a journey (optionally on one step), linkable to a T01 row (REQ-PB-025).",
    "transformations", "as journey",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("journey_id", "uuid", null=False),
     Col("step_key", "uuid", doc="Key of a step in journey.steps (NULL = whole journey)"),
     TEXT("description", 2000, null=False),
     Col("diagnostic_item_id", "uuid", doc="Linked T01 row"),
     ENUM("status", ["active", "archived"], default="active"),
     *ARCHIVE(), *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("journey_pain_point"), tr_fk("journey_pain_point", "journey_id", "journey"),
                 tr_fk("journey_pain_point", "diagnostic_item_id", "diagnostic_item"),
                 archive_check("journey_pain_point")],
    after=["CREATE INDEX journey_pain_point_journey_idx ON journey_pain_point (journey_id);"],
    status="active | archived")

content.text: Part 3: workflows (0017) — decisions, workshops, actions, dependencies and the product-gate engine tables.

input.content:
from model import *

GATE_STATUSES = ["draft", "submitted", "under_review", "changes_requested", "approved", "rejected", "deferred"]

decision = Table(
    "decision", "THE canonical decision record (one decision model): T04 design decisions (kind = design) in P2, gate "
    "decisions (kind = gate, specialised by gate_decision), T16 executive decisions (kind = executive, P4).",
    "workflows", "create/update: TL, WL (decision.edit); decide: the named decision owner holding decision.decide",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     ENUM("kind", ["design", "executive", "gate"]),
     Col("code", "text", null=False, doc="D-01, D-02… (design); DEC-01… (executive); GD-01… (gate); per transformation"),
     TEXT("title", 500, null=False, doc="Decision required"),
     TEXT("context", 20000),
     USER("owner_user_id", doc="Decision owner (required before G3 for open design decisions)"),
     Col("due_date", "date", doc="Due"),
     ENUM("status", ["open", "decided", "deferred", "cancelled"], default="open", doc="Status: new decisions are Open"),
     Col("recommendation_option_id", "uuid", doc="Recommendation (an option of this decision) ..."),
     TEXT("recommendation_text", 4000, doc="... and its rationale"),
     Col("chosen_option_id", "uuid"),
     TEXT("outcome_text", 8000, doc="Decision rationale / outcome"),
     USER("decided_by"), Col("decided_at", "timestamptz"),
     Col("tom_dimension_code", "text", ref="tom_dimension (code)"),
     Col("source_workshop_item_id", "uuid", doc="Workshop item it was converted from (REQ-PB-042)"),
     *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[
        tr_unique("decision"),
        "CONSTRAINT decision_code_key UNIQUE (transformation_id, code)",
        "CONSTRAINT decision_id_kind_key UNIQUE (id, kind)",
        "CONSTRAINT decision_code_format CHECK ((kind = 'design' AND code ~ '^D-[0-9]{2,6}$') "
        "OR (kind = 'executive' AND code ~ '^DEC-[0-9]{2,6}$') OR (kind = 'gate' AND code ~ '^GD-[0-9]{2,6}$'))",
        "CONSTRAINT decision_decided_complete CHECK ((status = 'decided') = (decided_at IS NOT NULL) AND (decided_at IS NULL) = (decided_by IS NULL))",
        "CONSTRAINT decision_gate_is_decided CHECK (kind <> 'gate' OR status = 'decided')",
        "CONSTRAINT decision_design_choice CHECK (kind <> 'design' OR status <> 'decided' OR chosen_option_id IS NOT NULL)",
        "CONSTRAINT decision_design_only_links CHECK (kind = 'design' OR (tom_dimension_code IS NULL AND source_workshop_item_id IS NULL))",
    ],
    after=[list_index("decision"),
           "CREATE INDEX decision_kind_status_idx ON decision (transformation_id, kind, status);",
           "CREATE INDEX decision_open_owner_idx ON decision (owner_user_id) WHERE status = 'open';"],
    status="open → decided | deferred | cancelled; deferred → open (gate decisions are created decided)",
    invariants=["Codes are generated from record_code_counter and unique per transformation.",
                "A decided design decision has a chosen option of its own (CHECK + composite FK)."])

decision_option = Table(
    "decision_option", "Options A / B / C… of a decision (B0065); also used by T16 in P4.",
    "workflows", "as decision",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("decision_id", "uuid", null=False),
     Col("label", "text", null=False, check="label ~ '^[A-Z]$'", doc="A, B, C…"),
     TEXT("title", 300, null=False), TEXT("description", 4000),
     Col("ordinal", "smallint", null=False, check="ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 26"),
     ENUM("status", ["active", "withdrawn"], default="active"),
     *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_fk("decision_option", "decision_id", "decision"),
                 "CONSTRAINT decision_option_label_key UNIQUE (decision_id, label)",
                 "CONSTRAINT decision_option_decision_id_id_key UNIQUE (decision_id, id)"],
    after=["ALTER TABLE decision\n"
           f"  ADD CONSTRAINT decision_recommendation_option_fkey FOREIGN KEY (id, recommendation_option_id) REFERENCES decision_option (decision_id, id) {RESTRICT},\n"
           f"  ADD CONSTRAINT decision_chosen_option_fkey FOREIGN KEY (id, chosen_option_id) REFERENCES decision_option (decision_id, id) {RESTRICT};"],
    status="active | withdrawn")

record_code_counter = Table(
    "record_code_counter", "Per-transformation counters for human-readable codes (D-01, DEC-01, GD-01, DEP-01).",
    "workflows", "system",
    [Col("transformation_id", "uuid", null=False, ref="transformation (id)"),
     ENUM("prefix", ["D", "DEC", "GD", "DEP"]),
     Col("last_value", "integer", null=False, check="last_value >= 0")],
    constraints=["PRIMARY KEY (transformation_id, prefix)"],
    guards="none", status="n/a (counter, not a business record; not versioned or audited)",
    invariants=["Next code = INSERT … ON CONFLICT (transformation_id, prefix) DO UPDATE SET last_value = last_value + 1 RETURNING last_value: gap-free under concurrency because the row lock serializes."])

tom_workshop = Table(
    "tom_workshop", "TOM canvas workshop (B0063): 90-120 minute session with business owners.",
    "workflows", "TL facilitates (workshop.facilitate); BO, WL contribute",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     TEXT("title", 300, null=False),
     Col("workshop_date", "date", null=False),
     Col("duration_minutes", "integer", null=False, check="duration_minutes BETWEEN 15 AND 480", doc="Guidance 90-120 (warning outside)"),
     TEXT("agenda", 20000),
     USER("facilitator_user_id", null=False),
     ENUM("status", ["planned", "in_progress", "closed"], default="planned"),
     Col("closed_at", "timestamptz"), USER("closed_by"),
     *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("tom_workshop"),
                 "CONSTRAINT tom_workshop_closed_complete CHECK ((status = 'closed') = (closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (closed_at IS NULL) = (closed_by IS NULL))"],
    after=[list_index("tom_workshop")],
    status="planned → in_progress → closed (close refused while unresolved items remain)")

tom_workshop_participant = Table(
    "tom_workshop_participant", "Participants of a TOM workshop (business owners flagged).",
    "workflows", "TL (workshop.facilitate)",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("workshop_id", "uuid", null=False),
     USER("user_id", null=False),
     Col("is_business_owner", "boolean", null=False, default="false"),
     ENUM("status", ["active", "removed"], default="active"),
     *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_fk("tom_workshop_participant", "workshop_id", "tom_workshop")],
    after=["CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tom_workshop_participant_active_key ON tom_workshop_participant (workshop_id, user_id) WHERE status = 'active';"],
    status="active | removed")

tom_workshop_item = Table(
    "tom_workshop_item", "A workshop contribution, or an unresolved item that must be converted into a design decision or an owned action.",
    "workflows", "TL, BO, WL; conversion by TL",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("workshop_id", "uuid", null=False),
     Col("dimension_code", "text", ref="tom_dimension (code)"),
     ENUM("kind", ["contribution", "unresolved"]),
     TEXT("body", 4000, null=False),
     USER("owner_user_id", doc="Required to convert"),
     ENUM("status", ["recorded", "open", "converted"], doc="contribution = recorded; unresolved: open → converted"),
     Col("converted_decision_id", "uuid"), Col("converted_action_id", "uuid"),
     Col("converted_at", "timestamptz"), USER("converted_by"),
     *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("tom_workshop_item"),
                 tr_fk("tom_workshop_item", "workshop_id", "tom_workshop"),
                 tr_fk("tom_workshop_item", "converted_decision_id", "decision"),
                 "CONSTRAINT tom_workshop_item_kind_status CHECK ((kind = 'contribution') = (status = 'recorded'))",
                 "CONSTRAINT tom_workshop_item_conversion CHECK ((status = 'converted') = (converted_at IS NOT NULL) "
                 "AND (converted_at IS NULL) = (converted_by IS NULL) "
                 "AND (status <> 'converted' OR (owner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND ((converted_decision_id IS NULL) <> (converted_action_id IS NULL)))) "
                 "AND (status = 'converted' OR (converted_decision_id IS NULL AND converted_action_id IS NULL)))"],
    after=["CREATE INDEX tom_workshop_item_workshop_idx ON tom_workshop_item (workshop_id, status);",
           """-- REQ-PB-042: a workshop cannot be closed while unresolved items remain unconverted.
CREATE FUNCTION tom_workshop_close_guard() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status = 'closed' AND OLD.status <> 'closed' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM tom_workshop_item i WHERE i.workshop_id = NEW.id AND i.kind = 'unresolved' AND i.status = 'open') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tom_workshop %: unresolved items must be converted before closing', NEW.id
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'tom_workshop_close_unresolved';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER tom_workshop_close_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON tom_workshop
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION tom_workshop_close_guard();""",
           "ALTER TABLE decision ADD CONSTRAINT decision_source_workshop_item_fkey\n"
           f"  FOREIGN KEY (transformation_id, source_workshop_item_id) REFERENCES tom_workshop_item (transformation_id, id) {RESTRICT};"],
    status="contribution: recorded; unresolved: open → converted",
    invariants=["Converted ⇒ an owner and exactly one of decision/action (CHECK)."])

action_item = Table(
    "action_item", "An owned action (P2: from workshop conversion; P4 extends it for RAID, meetings and corrective actions).",
    "workflows", "TL, TO (action.edit); the owner updates own (action.update_own)",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     TEXT("title", 500, null=False), TEXT("description", 4000),
     USER("owner_user_id", null=False),
     Col("due_date", "date"),
     ENUM("status", ["open", "in_progress", "done", "cancelled"], default="open"),
     Col("source_workshop_item_id", "uuid"),
     *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("action_item"), tr_fk("action_item", "source_workshop_item_id", "tom_workshop_item")],
    after=[list_index("action_item"),
           "ALTER TABLE tom_workshop_item ADD CONSTRAINT tom_workshop_item_converted_action_id_fkey\n"
           f"  FOREIGN KEY (transformation_id, converted_action_id) REFERENCES action_item (transformation_id, id) {RESTRICT};"],
    status="open → in_progress → done; cancelled")

dependency = Table(
    "dependency", "THE canonical dependency record shared by T08 and RAID (P2 subset: TOM-level dependencies; P3 adds "
    "initiative endpoints and cycle checks).",
    "workflows", "TL, WL, TO, TD (dependency.edit)",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("code", "text", null=False, check="code ~ '^DEP-[0-9]{2,6}$'"),
     TEXT("description", 2000, null=False, doc="Dependency"),
     ENUM("from_kind", ["initiative", "external", "tom_dimension", "decision", "other"]), TEXT("from_label", 300),
     ENUM("to_kind", ["initiative", "external", "tom_dimension", "decision", "other"]), TEXT("to_label", 300),
     ENUM("dependency_type", ["decision", "tech", "data", "vendor", "other"]),
     Col("needed_by", "date"),
     USER("owner_user_id"),
     ENUM("status", ["open", "at_risk", "resolved", "archived"], default="open"),
     TEXT("mitigation", 4000),
     Col("tom_dimension_code", "text", ref="tom_dimension (code)"),
     Col("decision_id", "uuid"),
     *ARCHIVE(), *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("dependency"), tr_fk("dependency", "decision_id", "decision"),
                 "CONSTRAINT dependency_code_key UNIQUE (transformation_id, code)",
                 archive_check("dependency")],
    after=[list_index("dependency"),
           "CREATE INDEX dependency_dimension_idx ON dependency (transformation_id, tom_dimension_code) WHERE status <> 'archived';"],
    status="open | at_risk → resolved; archived")

gate_instance = Table(
    "gate_instance", "A product gate (G1-G6) of one transformation: status, configured approver, current submission. "
    "Business approval inside the product; unrelated to engineering gates DG0-DG7.",
    "workflows", "TL submits (gate.submit); TO configures the approver (gate.configure)",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("gate_code", "text", null=False, ref="gate_definition (code)"),
     ENUM("status", GATE_STATUSES, default="draft"),
     Col("approver_role_code", "text", null=False, ref="role (code)", doc="Configured approver role (default SP)"),
     USER("approver_user_id", doc="Optional named approver (must hold the role and gate.decide)"),
     Col("current_submission_id", "uuid"),
     Col("latest_submission_no", "integer", null=False, default="0", check="latest_submission_no >= 0"),
     Col("approved_at", "timestamptz"),
     *STAMPS()],
    constraints=[tr_unique("gate_instance"),
                 "CONSTRAINT gate_instance_gate_key UNIQUE (transformation_id, gate_code)",
                 "CONSTRAINT gate_instance_approved_complete CHECK ((status = 'approved') = (approved_at IS NOT NULL))",
                 "CONSTRAINT gate_instance_draft_unsubmitted CHECK ((status = 'draft') = (latest_submission_no = 0) "
                 "AND (current_submission_id IS NULL) = (latest_submission_no = 0))"],
    after=["""CREATE FUNCTION gate_instance_approver_allowed() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gate_definition d
                 WHERE d.code = NEW.gate_code AND NEW.approver_role_code = ANY (d.allowed_approver_role_codes)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'gate %: role % is not an allowed approver', NEW.gate_code, NEW.approver_role_code
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'gate_instance_approver_allowed';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER gate_instance_approver_allowed BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF approver_role_code ON gate_instance
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION gate_instance_approver_allowed();"""],
    status="draft → submitted → (under_review) → approved | rejected | changes_requested | deferred; "
           "changes_requested | rejected | deferred → submitted (resubmission); submitted → submitted (supersede)",
    invariants=["One instance per (transformation, gate); the approver role is one of the definition's allowed roles (trigger)."])

SUB_MUTABLE = ["status", "superseded_at", "superseded_by_submission_id", "version", "updated_at", "updated_by"]
gate_submission = Table(
    "gate_submission", "A versioned submission of a gate with its immutable evidence snapshot (REQ-S04-002).",
    "workflows", "TL (gate.submit)",
    [ID(), ORG(), TR(),
     Col("gate_instance_id", "uuid", null=False),
     Col("gate_code", "text", null=False, ref="gate_definition (code)"),
     Col("submission_no", "integer", null=False, check="submission_no >= 1", doc="The submission version a decision must name"),
     ENUM("status", ["pending", "superseded", "decided", "withdrawn"], default="pending"),
     USER("submitted_by", null=False),
     Col("submitted_at", "timestamptz", null=False, default="now()"),
     TEXT("submission_note", 4000),
     Col("approver_role_code", "text", null=False, ref="role (code)", doc="Assignee role resolved at submission"),
     USER("approver_user_id", doc="Assignee person when configured"),
     Col("due_date", "date"),
     Col("charter_id", "uuid"), Col("charter_version_no", "integer"),
     Col("snapshot", "jsonb", null=False, check="jsonb_typeof(snapshot) = 'object'",
         doc="{records: [{recordType, recordId, version}], evidence: [{evidenceId, reviewStatus, contentSha256}]}"),
     Col("snapshot_sha256", "char(64)", null=False, check="snapshot_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'"),
     Col("superseded_at", "timestamptz"),

--   the methodology pin, the six seeded T01 rows, the ten TOM canvas boxes and the six product gate instances.
-- Idempotent (re-running creates nothing twice) and serialized per transformation by the row lock. Every row it creates
-- gets its own audit event, so the deferred audit_required triggers are satisfied.
--   p_actor_user_id  the creating user when called by the API in the POST /transformations transaction (actor 'user');
--                    NULL for a migration backfill (actor 'system', on behalf of the transformation's creator).
--   p_source         'api' | 'worker' | 'cli' | 'migration' (audit_event.source).
CREATE FUNCTION p2_instantiate_transformation(p_transformation_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_request_id text, p_source text)
RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  t record;
  mv uuid;
  rid uuid;
  creator uuid;
  a_type text := CASE WHEN p_actor_user_id IS NULL THEN 'system' ELSE 'user' END;
  on_behalf uuid;
  created integer := 0;
  r record;
BEGIN
  SELECT x.id, x.organization_id, x.created_by INTO t FROM transformation x WHERE x.id = p_transformation_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'transformation % does not exist', p_transformation_id USING ERRCODE = 'no_data_found';
  END IF;
  creator := coalesce(p_actor_user_id, t.created_by);
  on_behalf := CASE WHEN p_actor_user_id IS NULL THEN t.created_by END;
  SELECT m.id INTO mv FROM methodology_version m WHERE m.key = 'playbook' AND m.status = 'published'
    ORDER BY m.version_no DESC LIMIT 1;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transformation_config_pin p WHERE p.transformation_id = t.id AND p.kind = 'methodology') THEN
    rid := mth_uuid_v7();
    INSERT INTO transformation_config_pin (id, organization_id, transformation_id, kind, methodology_version_id, pinned_by,
                                           created_by, updated_by)
    VALUES (rid, t.organization_id, t.id, 'methodology', mv, creator, creator, creator);
    INSERT INTO audit_event (id, organization_id, transformation_id, actor_type, actor_user_id, on_behalf_of_user_id, action,
                             record_type, record_id, new_version, request_id, source)
    VALUES (mth_uuid_v7(), t.organization_id, t.id, a_type, p_actor_user_id, on_behalf, 'transformation_config_pin.create',
            'transformation_config_pin', rid, 1, p_request_id, p_source);
    created := created + 1;
  END IF;

  FOR r IN SELECT d.code FROM diagnostic_dimension d WHERE d.is_source_seeded AND d.status = 'active' ORDER BY d.ordinal LOOP
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM diagnostic_item i WHERE i.transformation_id = t.id AND i.dimension_code = r.code AND i.is_seeded) THEN
      rid := mth_uuid_v7();
      INSERT INTO diagnostic_item (id, organization_id, transformation_id, dimension_code, is_seeded, created_by, updated_by)
      VALUES (rid, t.organization_id, t.id, r.code, true, creator, creator);
      INSERT INTO audit_event (id, organization_id, transformation_id, actor_type, actor_user_id, on_behalf_of_user_id, action,
                               record_type, record_id, new_version, request_id, source)
      VALUES (mth_uuid_v7(), t.organization_id, t.id, a_type, p_actor_user_id, on_behalf, 'diagnostic_item.create',
              'diagnostic_item', rid, 1, p_request_id, p_source);
      created := created + 1;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  FOR r IN SELECT d.code FROM tom_dimension d ORDER BY d.ordinal LOOP
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tom_canvas_cell c WHERE c.transformation_id = t.id AND c.dimension_code = r.code) THEN
      rid := mth_uuid_v7();
      INSERT INTO tom_canvas_cell (id, organization_id, transformation_id, dimension_code, created_by, updated_by)
      VALUES (rid, t.organization_id, t.id, r.code, creator, creator);
      INSERT INTO audit_event (id, organization_id, transformation_id, actor_type, actor_user_id, on_behalf_of_user_id, action,
                               record_type, record_id, new_version, request_id, source)
      VALUES (mth_uuid_v7(), t.organization_id, t.id, a_type, p_actor_user_id, on_behalf, 'tom_canvas_cell.create',
              'tom_canvas_cell', rid, 1, p_request_id, p_source);
      created := created + 1;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  FOR r IN SELECT g.code, g.default_approver_role_code FROM gate_definition g ORDER BY g.ordinal LOOP
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gate_instance gi WHERE gi.transformation_id = t.id AND gi.gate_code = r.code) THEN
      rid := mth_uuid_v7();
      INSERT INTO gate_instance (id, organization_id, transformation_id, gate_code, approver_role_code, created_by, updated_by)
      VALUES (rid, t.organization_id, t.id, r.code, r.default_approver_role_code, creator, creator);
      INSERT INTO audit_event (id, organization_id, transformation_id, actor_type, actor_user_id, on_behalf_of_user_id, action,
                               record_type, record_id, new_version, request_id, source)
      VALUES (mth_uuid_v7(), t.organization_id, t.id, a_type, p_actor_user_id, on_behalf, 'gate_instance.create',
              'gate_instance', rid, 1, p_request_id, p_source);
      created := created + 1;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN created;
END $$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION p2_instantiate_transformation(uuid, uuid, text, text) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION p2_instantiate_transformation(uuid, uuid, text, text) TO mth_app;

-- Backfill: transformations created before P2 (development and demo databases) get the same starter structure, audited
-- as actor 'system' on behalf of their creator. On a fresh database this selects no rows.
SELECT p2_instantiate_transformation(x.id, NULL, NULL, 'migration') FROM transformation x ORDER BY x.created_at, x.id;"""

  creator := coalesce(p_actor_user_id, t.created_by);

    VALUES (mth_uuid_v7(), t.organization_id, t.id, a_type, p_actor_user_id, on_behalf, 'transformation_config_pin.create',
